passages.printed_error: The third line of the z_(j+1) expansion has numerator 3^m(2^A-3^m)y_j + 3^m C - 2^A C.
passages.correct_expansion: The preceding line gives numerator 3^m(2^A-3^m)y_j + (2^A-3^m)C - 2^A C = 3^m((2^A-3^m)y_j-C).
passages.diagnosis: The erroneous displayed equality is real in both PDFs, not text-extraction corruption. Its successor, z_(j+1)=(3^m/2^A)z_j, is correct. The error is local algebra in an intermediate line; it does not invalidate the integrality/divisibility proof after that line is corrected.
passages.retained_scope: The printed argument uses integer y_j, positive exponents A>=m>=1, coprimality of3^m and2^A, then 2^(jA)|z0 for everyj. The theorem states exact periodicity from the beginning of the stipulated exponent tail, not merely eventual convergence.
passages.other_differences: Controlling PDF refers to block fixed point by ??; indexed PDF resolves it to Theorem9.1. Both have the same mathematical error and the same correct final recurrence.

passages.printed_domain_phrase: as a formal power series, and hence on the open unit disc
passages.formal_part: Coefficient identity (2^A-3^m)X_m(A)=2^A S_m(A) and uniqueness in q^m C[[q]] are explicitly proved; 2^A-3^m is nonzero.
passages.diagnosis: The implication to the entire unit disc is false for m=2 under the stated power-series meanings. It is not a PDF version difference. This diagnosis does not refute the formal identity or its formal uniqueness.
passages.bounded_countercheck: For m=2, summing c(a,A-a)=(3+2^a)/2^A over1<=a<=A-1 gives S_2(A)=1+(3A-5)/2^A. Thus X_2(A)=(2^A+3A-5)/(2^A-9) tends1. At q=1/2 (inside the claimed open unit disc), X_2(2q)=X_2(1) diverges since its terms do not tend0. F_2(1)=3v(1)^2+u(1)v(1) has a pole. The natural common Taylor-series domain for m=2 is |q|<1/2.
passages.exception: For m=1, X_1(A)=1/(2^A-3) has radius2 and F_1=v has radius2, so the stated dilated identity does hold for |q|<1. The defect is the assertion for everym>=1 without distinguishing the domain.
passages.other_differences: The controlling PDF has unresolved equation/theorem references; indexed PDF supplies references17.1,17 and Theorems15.3/14.1. No correction of the unit-disc phrase occurs in the indexed PDF.
passages.not_claimed: No complete analytic continuation/pole classification proved in this witness task; other task owns the general analytic reconstruction.
